description: Assembles EVERYTHING about a settled transfer in one call: the on-chain verification, the unit-by-unit fee breakdown, what the alternative route would have cost, and whether the delivery time is measured or estimated — signed as a whole. This is the artefact to hand to a principal who was not there; swapping any component invalidates the signature. READ `verdict` BEFORE PRESENTING IT: the bundle verdict is the WEAKEST of its parts. A complete fee breakdown does not mean the transfer was confirmed — if `verdict` is `undetermined`, settlement was NOT verified and you must not describe it as complete. Components that could not be produced appear as `unavailable` with a reason; check `incomplete`.

minAmount.description: assert the minimum that should have arrived

recipient.description: assert who should have been paid

name: robyn_evidence_bundle
title: One signed bundle of all evidence about a transfer
